product.title: Glowing Kayak Tour Port O'Connor - Bar Room Bay

description.text: Paddle clear kayaks fitted with underwater LED lights on a guided night outing from Port O'Connor near Houston. The route moves through the Intracoastal Waterway toward Bar Room Bay with a chance to spot marine life illuminated beneath the hull. Stops include Port O'Connor Launch, Intracoastal Waterway, Bar Room Bay. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
